author: Bobby Grayson
description: The LiveView fixture found a latent bug that had nothing to do with LiveView. covered_tags/3 returns the list of message tags a module covers exhaustively, and prepended the atom :all as a sentinel meaning "the bare-message clauses cover every state". A module with a message tag literally named :all therefore looked fully covered: insert_crashes would emit no crash clause for its uncovered cast/call tags and no global catch-all, and Lean would reject the generated file with a missing-cases error (or, worse for a cast tag, the model would silently not crash where the BEAM would). The sentinel is :__every__ now, which no Elixir atom tag can be. Found because my first draft of the reply fixture used handle_call(:all, ...) for "give me everything".
title: Sentinel collision: a module with a :all message tag defeated the coverage check
